description: ESP32-C3 Supermini (RISC-V rv32imc), NobroRTOS portable-core port over USB-Serial-JTAG

firmware_generation.interrupts: owned by the maintained ESP32-C3 port and selected esp-hal providers
firmware_generation.dma: provider-specific and never inferred from application task names
firmware_generation.clock: esp-hal startup owns clock selection and timer calibration
firmware_generation.boot: ESP image metadata and partition offset are owned by the maintained port
